items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I've heard a lot of guitar players... But nobody played like Snooza.

ctx.x: He's got a brother that's a barber. He's got a barber shop over there. In Bogalooza. You never heard anything like it, Bill. I've heard a lot of guitar players. I've heard Lang and all those, Segovia. But nobody played like Snooza. The guy was just, he was out of the world.
Did he ever play here in the city with many of the bands?
